text: Moving right (l) into a new column feels slow
description:
Pressing l into a new column feels slow; the user's sense (2026-10-31) is that it's data loading or virtual-scroll calculation, not the 0.3s slide.

Measured 2026-10-31 in the live app (Chrome, dev build): moving between columns with h/l showed no long tasks (>50ms) and no key event handling over 16ms. The window was in the background, so frame timings weren't trustworthy, and the session couldn't reach a column that shifts the window (already at the deepest phase level). Not reproduced yet.

Suspects left when a new column appears: the 0.3s transform slide on .columns-layout, the column first rendering with estimated entry heights and then jumping as they're measured (Column.vue measureEntryElement + useColumnScroll shift), and the smooth scroll that reveals the selection. Next step: a DevTools Performance recording of one slow l press (the user's), or name the exact column/idea where it's slow.

status.comment: Not reproducible by an agent (2026-10-31 measurement found no long tasks). Felix: when it feels slow again, name the column/idea where you pressed l, or record one press with the DevTools Performance panel and save the trace.
